title: Next Permutation
goal: Solve Next Permutation: Find the rightmost ascent, exchange its pivot with the next larger suffix value, and reverse the suffix to make the smallest possible increase.
strategy: Find the rightmost ascent, exchange its pivot with the next larger suffix value, and reverse the suffix to make the smallest possible increase.
edgeCases: A fully descending permutation wraps to ascending order; equal values must not create a false ascent.
